msg.content: List the female winners of the Nobel Prize in 2019 or 2020 and specify the category they won in.
List the female winners of the Nobel Prize in 2019 or 2020 and specify the category they won in.

content.content:
The user wants a list of female winners of the Nobel Prize in 2019 or 2020 and specify the category they won in. Need to provide list of female laureates from those years, across all Nobel categories (Peace, Literature, Physics, Chemistry, Medicine, Economic Sciences). In 2020, the Nobel Prize in Economic Sciences was awarded to Paul Milgrom and Robert Wilson (both male). In 2020, female laureates: Chemistry - Emmanuelle Charpentier (female) and Jennifer Doudna (female). Physics - Roger Penrose (male), Reinhard Genzel (male), Andrea Ghez (female). Medicine - Harvey J. Alter (male), Michael Houghton (male), Charles M. Rice (male). Peace - World Food Programme (organization). Literature - Louise Glück (female). So female winners in 2020: Emmanuelle Charpentier (Chemistry), Jennifer Doudna (Chemistry), Andrea Ghez (Physics), Louise Glück (Literature). Also maybe there is a female in Peace? No, it's an organization. So list those.

In 2019, female laureates: Physics - James Peebles (male), Michel Mayor (male), Didier Queloz (male) none female. Chemistry - John B. Goodenough (male), M. Stanley Whittingham (male), Akira Yoshino (male) none female. Medicine - William G. Kaelin Jr. (male), Sir Peter J. Ratcliffe (male), Gregg L. Semenza (male) none female. Peace - Abiy Ahmed (male). Literature - Peter Handke (male). Economic Sciences - Abhijit Banerjee (male), Esther Duflo (female), Michael Kremer (male). So female: Esther Duflo (Economic Sciences). Also maybe there is a female in Peace? Not 2019. So just Esther Duflo.

Thus total female laureates in 2019 and 2020: list them with category.

We need to verify if any other female laureates in 2019: I recall 2019 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine went to William G. Kaelin Jr., Sir Peter J. Ratcliffe, and Gregg L. Semenza – all male. 2019 Nobel Peace Prize went to Abiy Ahmed – male. 2019 Literature – Peter Handke – male. So only Esther Duflo.

Thus answer: list:

- 2019 – Economic Sciences – Esther Duflo (France/USA) – for her experimental approach to alleviating global poverty.

- 2020 – Chemistry – Emmanuelle Charpentier – CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing.

- 2020 – Chemistry – Jennifer Doudna – same.

- 2020 – Physics – Andrea Ghez – discovery of supermassive black hole.

- 2020 – Literature – Louise Glück – poet.

Potentially also 2020 Peace? No.

Thus produce answer.

content:
**Female Nobel laureates in 2019 and 2020**

| Year | Category (Nobel Prize) | Laureate | Note |
|------|------------------------|----------|------|
| **2019** | Economic Sciences | **Esther Duflo** (France/USA) | Recognized “for their experimental approach to alleviating global poverty.” |
| **2020** | Chemistry | **Emmanuelle Charpentier** (France) | Shared the prize for the development of the CRISPR‑Cas9 genome‑editing method. |
|  | Chemistry | **Jennifer Doudna** (USA) | Shared the prize with Charpentier for the same CRISPR‑Cas9 breakthrough. |
|  | Physics | **Andrea Ghez** (USA) | Honored “for the discovery of a supermassive compact object at the centre of our galaxy.” |
|  | Literature | **Louise Glück** (USA) | Awarded “for her unmistakable poetic voice that, with austere beauty, makes

   universal experience.” |

*No other women received Nobel Prizes in 2019 or 2020.*
